protocol.name: D15 read-only D14 held-out commitment alias audit
protocol.purpose: distinguish snapshot-input ambiguity, learned-representation collapse, and mapping failure for D14 held-out commitment misses
protocol.scope: D3+D12 TRAIN fit and validation folds only; no model fitting, DEV, or TEST

distances.raw_scene: RMS over D14 graph node/edge/gripper inputs, minimized over all six anonymous object permutations
distances.raw_action: RMS over endpoint-symmetric eight-step gripper-relative controls at all six levels
distances.raw_joint: equal-weight RMS combination of raw_scene and raw_action
distances.learned: RMS over fit-standardized mean/max pooled D14 pair embeddings
distances.zero_sign_rule: positive iff unchanged physical commitment delta-BIC is greater than zero

subsets.primary_errors: reference commitment positive and D14 predicted commitment non-positive
subsets.negative_added: reference commitment non-positive and D14 predicted commitment positive

predeclared_markers.raw_snapshot_alias_pressure: primary-error median raw 5-neighbor same-sign purity below 0.60 and median nearest-opposite/nearest-same ratio at most 1.25
predeclared_markers.learned_representation_collapse: primary-error median raw purity at least 0.80 but learned purity below 0.60
predeclared_markers.mapping_or_coverage_failure: primary-error median raw purity at least 0.80 and learned purity at least 0.60
